b) Reference cue: the plate spans about 2.5 to 3 times the length of the visible salmon-like fillet piece (about 9-10 cm long). Using a fork-length reference (about 19 cm) against the plate height in the frame, the plate is about 1.3-1.4 forks wide, which points to roughly 25 cm.
